newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon July property tax revenues slightly down.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon July property tax revenues slightly down.

text.p: Lebanese government revenues from taxation of property deals fell 0.57 percent in July over the same month last year, according to figures released by the finance ministry on Tuesday.
The ministry collected $16,970,790 compared with $17,067,305 in July 1996. Last month, it collected $13,943,110.
Collected property tax revenues for the first seven months of 1997 totalled $87,774,201 compared with $78,825,127 over the same period a year earlier -- a rise of 11.35 percent.
Tax rates on property deals vary from district to district, but average about 6.5 percent.
However, tax collection does not truly reflect the state of the market because deals are sometimes understated to avoid tax, property analysts say.
